fields.name: Lemma
fields.description: Select the lemma (dictionary entry) this sentence demonstrates or relates to. The lemma language should match the sentence language.
fields.guidance: Choose the main word or concept that this sentence illustrates. Use the dropdown to search and select the appropriate lemma. Once you select a lemma, optional fields for Meaning and Surface Form will populate if available.

actions: Verify the sentence appears correctly linked to the lemma
Optionally refine the link by selecting a specific Meaning or Surface Form if needed
Review the link type to ensure it accurately categorizes the relationship
Check that linked sentences help demonstrate the lemma's usage in context
